Most are repeated result_large_err on exact closed refusal DTOs; real diagnostics include two dead items, one type-complexity signature, two nonminimal counter predicates, two manual saturating additions, one needless lifetime, two cloned-ref slices, and one no-op clone. allowed_scope: Edit only the nine manifest files. Do not edit compiler charter_product, CLI approvers/product tests, engine charter_promotion_workflow, docs, schemas, definitions, proof/control/handoff/ledger.
Apply narrow semantics-preserving lint fixes and justified narrow lint allowances where exact reviewed DTO layout makes boxing or public contract changes inappropriate.
non_goals: Do not change public DTO/request/result shapes, authority record bytes, lock/recovery behavior, counters, operation ordering, frozen CLI grammar, dependencies, or HCM-2.3.
Do not use cargo fix broadly, delete tests, weaken -D warnings, add crate-wide blanket allows, or commit.
tasks: Verify all subject hashes and run GitNexus upstream impact before modifying every existing function/method/struct symbol. Warn and stop at any HIGH/CRITICAL semantic edit; additive cfg/import/attribute-only changes must remain byte/behavior neutral.
Reproduce the strict lint wall. Fix the exact mechanical diagnostics with explicit equivalence tests where arithmetic/counter logic changes text.
For result_large_err, preserve exact reviewed public refusal DTO layouts and use the narrowest justified module/item lint scope rather than boxing or schema/layout changes.

Resolve dead items honestly: consume/remove an obsolete private field/function when safe, or add a narrowly documented allowance only when it is an intentional retained internal seam. Do not create fake calls.

Cfg-gate platform imports/statics or rename retained guard fields without changing filesystem/lock behavior. Remove obsolete dead CLI Charter helper code only if source/test inspection proves no caller and focused behavior remains covered; otherwise report it.

Run focused authority/intake/identity tests after edits, then iterate `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` until green or report the next exact out-of-scope diagnostics. Run workspace tests proportionate to changes, fmt check, diff check, and GitNexus detect-changes.
contracts_and_gates: No semantic output, record, fingerprint, counter, durability, request/result schema, or product behavior change.
Strict workspace all-target Clippy is the target gate; allowances must be narrow and justified by frozen exact contracts.
No overlap with active product or promotion-projection source files.
stop_conditions: Stop before HIGH/CRITICAL semantic edits, public layout changes, broad lint suppression, or any out-of-manifest edit; report the exact remaining diagnostic instead.
If removing a dead helper would change a test-only compatibility contract, retain it with a narrow reasoned allowance and report the rationale.
